variants.suspected_cause: The repeated draw sequence used the descriptor at 50C0 twice and moved the 52A6 descriptor to the wrong phase.
variants.controlled_change: Swap the fourth draw descriptor to 52A6 in the five-frame loop and restore 50C0 in the post-loop refresh.

predicted_effect.note: Only pointer identities change; each call retains the same argument count and instruction widths.
